headline: A rewrite of a case judged at 09:16: Viatris's agreed $36.50 tender for Pacira, a routine deal step
reasoning: Source: Viatris's release on PR Newswire, retold by Benzinga at 09:31 ET: 'Viatris Inc. has officially commenced a cash tender offer to acquire all outstanding shares of Pacira BioSciences for $36.50 per share ... scheduled to expire on November 16, 2026'.
The crew judged the 08:43 ET Newsdesk version of this exact event in this morning's second pass and turned it away as a routine step on an agreed deal.
